MEDICAL STAFF LET DOWN BADLY BY THEIR COLLEAGUES IN RECEPTION.

I and my family have been registered at Beith Medical Centre for nearly 20 years, so have had dealings with them many times. To be clear, I can't thank the medical professionals there enough for the care they provide; they are uniformly brilliant.

With this in mind, it's a real shame that this facility's reputation is repeatedly trashed by the discourteous and unhelpful receptionists employed there. I have lost count of the number of times that they have been abrupt, sarcastic and dismissive when I have spoken to them. The most recent example of this (which prompted this review) occurred last Thursday (24 April 25) when I attempted to book a follow-up phone call with the Nurse Practitioner for my daughter, in compliance with instructions received in an earlier consultation. As requested on their website, I initially tried to do this electronically on their 'e-consult' platform, however it had been closed so I phoned the surgery instead. After explaining the issue, the receptionist initially refused to book a phone call, instead insisting that I try 'e-consult' again on the following day. When I asked why we couldn't just do it now over the phone, she eventually agreed after much tutting and sighing. I realise that this incident is minor, however I've had similar experiences so many times now that this one was 'the straw that broke the camel's back'.
